title: Let a Customer see what is on offer
objective: Ship E3's MVP: browsing the Meals Cooks currently have on offer, and reaching the kitchen behind any of them. No migration, no Edge Function, no vendor.
acceptance_criteria: a Customer with nothing installed and nobody signed in sees every Meal on offer and no draft, unavailable or archived one
a Cook whose Meals are all drafts is absent from discovery entirely, and taking the last Meal off the menu removes the kitchen
nothing on offer anywhere produces words saying so, never a blank screen (FR-006)
SC-001 verified by name: a Meal's full details are three actions from arriving
notes:
The MVP, and deliberately the thinnest package in E3. Browsing is answered entirely by the policies E2 already shipped, so this ships before anything expensive is started. It also carries Setup and Foundational (T101-T110), because the domain entities it creates are what every later package builds on. T104 says to read the spike report before US2 starts; it is here so the next worker inherits it. Shares both ARB files with WP-013, WP-015, WP-016 and WP-017 — every user-facing package in this repository does.
